race.description: The Springfield Mo Men Fundraiser Hcp (C2)
race.comment: BARRELLING (2) drops back from metro company after giving a bold sight at Doomben last start, where he held on for a gritty fourth. He was below expectations as a short odds-on favourite at this track two back, but Ryan Maloney returning is a significant plus. NINJITZOU (13) brings a sharp second-up profile after a close CL4 placing at this venue, where he was steadied and still finished within a length. IMPACT ZONE (7) comes back from Saturday BM65 grade and his Sunshine Coast third two runs ago reads well, though 1350m is new territory. Suspect he will be a touch vulnerable late in the piece. TEN GOOD REASONS (1) fought on strongly on heavy ground at the Sunshine Coast and has the wet-track record to keep him right in the race. Only needs to hold his form to be competitive again.
